request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Set a fixed cap of 500,000,000 ada on total Treasury Withdrawals debited during the specified period.
Record DRep agreement to the Net Change Limit if Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake.
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period while not authorizing any Treasury Withdrawal.
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for the Cardano Treasury.
The proposed limit applies from the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 through the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only the cumulative lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada limit and are not reset, reversed, reopened, or reauthorized by this action.
The proposed 500,000,000 ada limit supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, including the previously agreed 350,000,000 ada limit.
The proposal states that the action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.

The proposer asserts that the existing 350,000,000 ada limit is becoming practically constrained and that a higher limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits.
The proposal says it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and references an IPFS copy of that constitution.

summary: The document proposes an Info Action establishing a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, defines how withdrawals count toward that cap, excludes inflows, counts prior debits in the period, and asserts constitutional compatibility and supersession of a prior 350,000,000 ada limit.
